_comment: Maps OpenWrt package names to NVD CPE specs 'part:vendor:product' (part a=application, o=operating-system). Every mapping below was verified against the NVD CVE API 2.0 (virtualMatchString) on 2026-11-15; the number in parentheses is the total CVE count the query returned. Unmapped components are reported as not assessed by triage, never dropped. Notes: curl CVEs live under vendor 'haxx' (the newer 'curl' vendor CPE exists but is nearly empty); dnsmasq's 2020 DRDoS series is split across 'dnsmasq' and 'the_kelleys' vendor CPEs; mbedtls is 'arm:mbed_tls' with an underscore; dropbear is 'dropbear_ssh_project:dropbear_ssh'.
